_comment: MCP servers JARVIS can reach through the `mcp` tool.
Copy this file to mcp_servers.json and edit. The real file is gitignored
because server configs tend to accumulate tokens.
Put secrets in .env and reference them here as ${VAR_NAME} — they are
expanded from the environment at startup, so no token belongs in this file.
Set enabled=false to keep a server configured but not started. Servers boot
in the background: a slow or broken one never blocks JARVIS from starting,
it just will not appear in the model's catalog.
Only add servers that give JARVIS something run_python cannot do on its own:
credentials or a persistent session. A filesystem, shell or fetch server is
redundant here — files, shell and browser already cover those.

playwright.description: Real browser automation with a persistent session: navigate, click, type, fill forms, read page structure, screenshot. Use when a site needs interaction or a login, rather than the browser primitive which only opens, searches and fetches.

github.description: Repositories, issues, pull requests, code search.

gmail.description: The user's own Gmail: search the inbox with Gmail query syntax (is:unread, from:, newer_than:1d), read full emails by ID, and mark them read/unread. Use when asked about emails, the inbox, or to summarize messages.
